question: Does adding game-to-game variance to each team effect's sampling noise (plays in one game are not independent) remove the early-season over-confidence that the calibration factor corrects?
verdict: Not the cause: the early over-confidence is almost unchanged (slope 0.37 -> 0.38 at weeks 4-5) and calibrated error is identical. compute.GAME_VAR stays False; the option remains for the yearly refit.
how: backtest_matchups.py --game-var --save, compared with the saved predictions without it
